nodes.label: graphify claude install (native CLAUDE.md integration)
nodes.rationale: Writes a '## graphify' section into a project's CLAUDE.md so future Claude Code sessions check/query the graph automatically, without a manual /graphify invocation.

nodes.label: --cluster-only flag
nodes.rationale: Reruns community clustering on the existing graph without re-extraction, for when structure needs refreshing but content hasn't changed.

nodes.label: God Nodes
nodes.rationale: Surfaces the most highly-connected nodes so architectural hubs/chokepoints are visible without manual grep across the codebase.

nodes.label: graphify query command
nodes.rationale: BFS/DFS traversal over the existing graph.json so codebase questions are answered from a scoped subgraph instead of re-reading raw source or the full GRAPH_REPORT.md.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge, never hide cohesion scores or token cost, never skip corpus-size warnings — keeps the EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS audit trail trustworthy for downstream decisions.

nodes.label: graphify hook install (post-commit hook)
nodes.rationale: Auto-rebuilds graph.json/GRAPH_REPORT.md after every commit for changed code files, with no background process and no LLM needed for code-only diffs.

nodes.label: --update flag
nodes.rationale: Re-extracts only new/changed files instead of a full rebuild, saving tokens and time; code-only changes skip the LLM entirely.
